title: Test Case 51: Verify Profile link is visible in the navigation bar
preconditions: Browser is open and the E-Shop homepage is loaded
expected: A 'Profile' link is visible in the navigation bar alongside Home, Products, and Cart links

title: Test Case 52: Verify Profile link displays correct label text
preconditions: Browser is open and the E-Shop homepage is loaded
steps: Locate the Profile link in the navigation bar

title: Test Case 53: Verify Profile link navigates to the profile page on click
preconditions: Browser is open and the E-Shop homepage is loaded
steps: Click the Profile link in the navigation bar
Observe the resulting URL and page content
expected: The browser navigates to the profile page (e.g. /profile) without errors

title: Test Case 54: Verify Profile link is accessible from the Products page
preconditions: Browser is open on the Products page
steps: Verify the Profile link is present
expected: Profile link is visible in the navbar on the Products page

title: Test Case 55: Verify Profile link is accessible from the Cart page
preconditions: Browser is open on the Cart page
steps: Verify the Profile link is present
expected: Profile link is visible in the navbar on the Cart page

title: Test Case 56: Verify Profile link has active styling when on the profile page
preconditions: Browser has navigated to the profile page
steps: Inspect the Profile link in the navbar
Check CSS class or styling of the Profile nav link
expected: Profile link has active/highlighted styling distinguishing it from inactive links

title: Test Case 57: Verify navbar displays all five links when Profile is added
preconditions: Browser is open and the E-Shop homepage is loaded
steps: Count all links in the navigation bar
expected: Navigation bar contains exactly five elements: E-Shop logo, Home, Products, Cart, and Profile

title: Test Case 58: Verify Free Shipping threshold text 'On orders over $50' is visible
preconditions: Browser is open and the E-Shop homepage is loaded
steps: Locate the Free Shipping feature card

title: Test Case 59: Verify Secure Payment description reads '100% secure transactions'
preconditions: Browser is open and the E-Shop homepage is loaded
steps: Locate the Secure Payment feature card

title: Test Case 60: Verify Easy Returns description reads '30-day return policy'
preconditions: Browser is open and the E-Shop homepage is loaded
steps: Locate the Easy Returns feature card

title: Test Case 61: Verify Shop Now button href points to the /products route
preconditions: Browser is open and the E-Shop homepage is loaded
steps: Inspect the href attribute of the Shop Now button
expected: The Shop Now button href is '/products' or the full products URL

title: Test Case 62: Verify Products page search input is visible when backend is unavailable
preconditions: Browser is open on the Products page with backend returning an error
steps: Observe the page while the backend returns an error
Check if the search input is rendered
expected: The search input field is visible on the Products page even when backend is unavailable

title: Test Case 63: Verify error message text on Products page references the backend server
steps: Read the error message text displayed on the page
expected: Error message reads 'Failed to load products. Please make sure the backend server is running.'

title: Test Case 64: Verify E-Shop logo is visible on all three main pages
steps: Verify E-Shop logo is visible in the navbar
Navigate to /products and verify logo is visible
Navigate to /cart and verify logo is visible
expected: E-Shop logo appears in the navbar on the Homepage, Products, and Cart pages

title: Test Case 65: Verify cart count badge displays in format '(N)' in navbar
preconditions: Browser is open and cart is empty
steps: Locate the Cart link in the navigation bar
Read the cart count badge text
expected: Cart link displays count in parentheses format, e.g. 'Cart (0)' when cart is empty
